variations.body: KraftCrew builds sustainably and honestly — activewear that fits real bodies starting a real fitness journey. Free 30-day returns mean no pressure. The current limited offer means no reason to wait.

output.copywriting_notes: Fitness beginners carry anxiety about fitting in at the gym — the honest, no-nonsense tone acknowledges this directly without being patronising. Free 30-day returns removes the financial risk of a first purchase, while the sustainable angle appeals to a value that Instagram Reels audiences increasingly respond to.
